title: When Models Hear What They Expect: Diagnosing Prosodic Heuristics in Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.30204v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) process speech and text jointly, yet whether they exploit prosodic cues for pragmatic inference or rely on surface acoustic patterns has received little systematic investigation. We address this through sarcasm detection, evaluating Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni on Mandarin Chinese and English under five modality conditions that decompose the contributions of lexical content, vocal semantics, and prosodic structure. Adding audio systematically inflates false positives without improving true positive detection. Acoustic error diagnosis reveals that model errors cluster on a shared stereotype of expressive prosody, namely elevated pitch and irregular pausing, that diverges from the actual cues marking sarcasm in both languages. Targeted manipulation of only these two dimensions causally confirms the heuristic, inducing false positive rates of up to 60%. Applying the same manipulation template to Gemin

translated_title: 当模型听到它们所预期的：诊断多模态讽刺检测中的韵律启发式
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）联合处理语音和文本，然而它们究竟是利用韵律线索进行语用推理，还是仅仅依赖表面声学模式，这一问题尚未得到系统性研究。我们通过讽刺检测来探讨这一问题，在普通话和英语上评估Qwen2.5-Omni和Qwen3-Omni，采用五种模态条件来分解词汇内容、语音语义和韵律结构的贡献。结果表明，添加音频会系统性地增加误报，而无法提升真阳性检测。声学错误诊断显示，模型错误集中于一种共同的表达性韵律刻板印象——即音调升高和不规则停顿——这与两种语言中实际标记讽刺的线索并不一致。仅针对这两个维度的定向操纵在因果上证实了这种启发式策略，可诱发高达60%的误报率。将相同的操纵模板应用于Gemin（原文截断于此）
tldr: 该研究首次系统揭示多模态大语言模型在讽刺检测中依赖“高音调+不规则停顿”的表达性韵律刻板印象而非真实讽刺线索，添加音频反而增加误报，仅操纵这两个声学维度即可因果性地诱发高达60%的误报率。
en_tdlr: The study reveals that multimodal LLMs rely on a prosodic stereotype of expressive speech (elevated pitch and irregular pausing) rather than genuine sarcasm cues, with audio input systematically inflating false positives, and targeted manipulation of just these two acoustic dimensions causally inducing false positive rates of up to 60%.
